# SoundCloud

> > SoundCloud is a global music streaming and audio sharing platform enabling creators to upload, distribute, and monetize content while listeners discover 320M+ tracks.

SoundCloud serves as both a music streaming service for listeners and a comprehensive creator platform for artists, DJs, and podcasters. The platform emphasizes artist empowerment through tools like SoundCloud Premier and provides advertising solutions for brands seeking to reach music audiences.

## Key Topics

- Music streaming
- Creator tools
- Artist monetization
- Audio sharing
- SoundCloud Premier
- DJ resources
- Content moderation
- Music distribution
- Advertising platform
- Accessibility compliance
- Embed player
- Artist partnerships
- Competitions
- Music discovery
- Creator resources

## Core Platform

- [Stream and listen to music online for free with SoundCloud](https://soundcloud.com): SoundCloud homepage: discover and stream 320M+ music tracks
- [Upload your music & audio and share it with the world.](https://soundcloud.com/upload): SoundCloud music upload and audio sharing platform
- [Advertise on SoundCloud](https://advertising.soundcloud.com): SoundCloud advertising platform for brands and creators
